email.verification.subject: Verify your {APP_NAME} email
email.verification.intro: Thank you for joining us at {APP_NAME}.
email.verification.action: Click on the button below to verify your email address.
email.verification.ignore: If you didn't recently register, please ignore this email.
email.passwordReset.subject: Reset your {APP_NAME} password
email.passwordReset.action: Click on the button below to reset your password.
email.passwordReset.ignore: If you didn't ask to reset your password, please ignore this email.
email.emailChange.subject: Confirm your {APP_NAME} new email address
email.emailChange.action: Click on the button below to confirm your new email address.
email.emailChange.ignore: If you didn't ask to change your email address, please ignore this email.
email.otp.subject: OTP for {APP_NAME}
email.otp.ignore: If you didn't ask for the one-time password, you can ignore this email.
email.authAlert.subject: Login from a new location
email.authAlert.notice: We noticed a login to your {APP_NAME} account from a new location:
email.authAlert.warning: If this wasn't you, you should immediately change your {APP_NAME} account password to revoke access from all other locations.
email.authAlert.fine: If this was you, you may disregard this email.
email.passkeyReset.subject: Reset your {APP_NAME} passkey
email.passkeyReset.action: Click on the button below to register a new passkey on this device. This link will replace any previously registered passkeys for your account.
email.passkeyReset.ignore: If you didn't ask to reset your passkey, you can ignore this email.
email.invitation.subject: You are invited to join {ORG_NAME} on {APP_NAME}
email.invitation.intro: {INVITER} invited you to join {ORG_NAME} on {APP_NAME} as {ROLE}.
email.invitation.expiry: The link works once and expires on {EXPIRES}.
email.invitation.ignore: If you did not expect this invitation, you can ignore this email.
